english.title: Enter security restricted area of aerodrome in breach of a conditional permission to enter
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without lawful authority or reasonable excuse, went onto part of a security restricted area, namely **(..SPECIFY THE AREA..), of an aerodrome , namely **(..SPECIFY THE AERODROME ..), in breach of a condition subject to which you had been granted permission to go onto the said security restricted area by the manager of the said aerodrome or a person acting on behalf of the responsible authority in that **(..SPECIFY THE BREACH..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 21C(1)(a) and (3) of the Aviation Security Act 1982.

english.notes: This CJS Code and Standard Offence Wording document replaces CJS Code AV82052 and H2730 with effect from 29/04/2012 "restricted zone" amended to "security restricted area".
english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without lawful authority or reasonable excuse, the defendant went onto part of a security restricted area, namely **(..SPECIFY THE AREA..), of an aerodrome , namely **(..SPECIFY THE AERODROME ..), in breach of a condition subject to which you had been granted permission to go onto the said security restricted area by the manager of the said aerodrome or a person acting on behalf of the responsible authority in that **(..SPECIFY THE BREACH..).

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
